abstract: Maintains international civil aviation dangerous goods route permits and transit approvals
system_message:
You are the Aviation regulatory compliance officer (REG), responsible for maintaining international civil aviation dangerous goods route permits, transit approvals, and tracking airfield security inspection records across transport corridors.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains international civil aviation dangerous goods route permits and transit approvals（CIVAV）
information_points.content:
REG-CIVAV-ZA5：When evaluated on a permit route coverage basis inclusive of emergency diversion airspaces, the Dangerous goods aviation permit approved status for the Dedicated feeder-to-intercontinental charter relay is false.
REG-CIVAV-COQ：Evaluated on a permit route coverage basis exclusive of emergency diversion airspaces, the Dangerous goods aviation permit approved status for the Direct transatlantic widebody freighter routing is false.
REG-CIVAV-84L：For the Dual-leg priority commercial belly-cargo transfer, the Dangerous goods aviation permit approved status is true when evaluated on a permit route coverage basis inclusive of emergency diversion airspaces.
REG-CIVAV-KL5：Evaluated on a permit route coverage basis inclusive of emergency diversion airspaces, the Dangerous goods aviation permit approved status for the Direct transatlantic widebody freighter routing is true.

information_points.title: Airfield security inspections（INSP）
information_points.content:
REG-INSP-QY6：The Direct transatlantic widebody freighter routing achieved a Ramp security audit rating of 92 points in standardized perimeter and restricted loading zone audits.
REG-INSP-24V：The Dedicated feeder-to-intercontinental charter relay attained a Ramp security audit rating of 85 points during airfield loading zone compliance inspections.
REG-INSP-WNJ：The Dual-leg priority commercial belly-cargo transfer registered a Ramp security audit rating of 98 points across restricted access loading area audits.
